answer: Locks are entered in garden, expire in karst, and zenith lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 171 aliases hence needs 42 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1004 identities would post 787 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
